sources.https://github.com/myon-bioinformatics/w: @layer components{.ui-panel,.ui-card{border:1px solid var(--ui-border);padding:1rem;margin:1rem 0}.ui-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:.75rem}.ui-tag{display:inline-block;border:1px solid var(--ui-border);padding:.1rem .4rem}.ui-button,.ui-input{font:inherit;background:var(--ui-panel);color:var(--ui-fg);border:1px solid var(--ui-border);padding:.6rem}.ui-muted{color:var(--ui-muted)}.ui-output{white-space:pre-wrap;overflow:auto;background:#d8dee4;color:#161b22;border:1px solid #8c959f;border-radius:4px;padding:.75rem}pre code,.ui-output code{color:inherit}pre.ui-output code{background:transparent}@media(max-width:480px){.ui-page{padding:.75rem}.ui-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.ui-card,.ui-panel{margin:.75rem 0;padding:.75rem}}}
